summary: Diff adds frontend Excel template generation/import/export using SheetJS loaded from a CDN, adds a production deployment guide, and introduces a backend migration module plus references to migration/storage mixins in backend/main.mo. However, the diff evidence does not show a backend bulk import API, and upgrade-safe stable persistence / upgrade hooks are not clearly evidenced in the truncated backend/main.mo excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement upgrade-safe persistent storage in the Motoko backend so that forms, dropdown options, reports, entities, import history, and authorization state survive canister upgrades and restarts.
missing_requirements.reason: The shown backend/main.mo excerpt still defines runtime maps/state as `let forms = Map.empty...`, etc. The diff summary does not show `stable` variables or explicit persistence wiring for these collections; persistence may exist elsewhere in the truncated portion, but it is not evidenced here.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add/modify backend upgrade hooks (and create backend/migration.mo only if necessary) to safely migrate existing in-memory data into stable storage during upgrade and restore it after upgrade.
missing_requirements.reason: A migration module is added and referenced via `(with migration = Migration.run)` in backend/main.mo, but the diff summary does not show any explicit preupgrade/postupgrade hooks or stable-state handoff/restore logic; it is therefore not verifiable from the provided excerpt whether upgrades will not trap and will restore correct data structures.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add necessary backend APIs to support bulk import efficiently (e.g., a bulk create endpoint and a structured response), while keeping existing single-record create and list APIs working unchanged.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend import in ExcelManager explicitly imports valid rows 'one by one' via `useCreateEntity()` and there is no diff evidence of a new backend bulk-create endpoint or structured bulk response.

hallucinated_features.description: Runtime loading of the SheetJS (xlsx) library from an external CDN (cdn.sheetjs.com) for template/import/export.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest asks for real Excel import/export/template generation but does not request (or mention) introducing a CDN-loaded third-party runtime dependency; this is an implementation choice added by the diff.
